newsitem.title: USA: D.H. Marketing Q1 pre-tax EPS $0.28.
newsitem.headline: D.H. Marketing Q1 pre-tax EPS $0.28.

text.p: D.H. Marketing & Consulting Inc on Monday reported first-quarter, pre-tax earnings of $0.28 per share, and predicted second-quarter, pre-tax earnings of at least $0.30 per share.

The company president and chief executive, David Hagen, said in a statement he believes "one or two financial institutions are currently short a large quantity of stock based upon their belief that our company cannot live up to its aggressive earnings growth plan. Not only has the company met the pre-tax earnings per share forecast made March 5, but has surpassed the estimate by a comfortable margin."
D.H. Marketing did not release after-tax figures.
